topic: Ada Blackjack, the last-minute hire who was the sole survivor of the failed 1921 Wrangel Island expedition
title: She Was Hired As An Afterthought. She Was The Only One Who Came Home.
description: AI-narrated commentary on the true story of Ada Blackjack, hired almost as an afterthought for a 1921 Arctic expedition sent to claim Wrangel Island for Britain -- and the only member of the five-person team who made it home. Original commentary and analysis, not a reproduction of any single source video.

hook_candidates.text: This mission's fifth hire was almost an afterthought. She's the only one who came home.
What happens when the person a five-person Arctic expedition almost didn't bring turns out to be the only one who survives it?
People assume an Arctic expedition's sole survivor would be one of its trained explorers. It wasn't.
In 1921, four men picked one extra hire almost as an afterthought to help claim an Arctic island for Britain. She's the only one who came home.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the coworker who always gets picked last on group projects, because they want to prove the backup hire is sometimes the only one who pulls through.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume the trained explorers on this mission were the ones who came home, but the hire who seemed like an afterthought was the only one who did.
closing_comment: Ada Blackjack was hired almost as an afterthought for this 1921 Wrangel Island expedition, and she's still the only one who ever came home.

sources.note: Confirms Ada Blackjack was hired as seamstress/cook and was the sole survivor of the 1921 Wrangel Island expedition.
Confirms the four men's deaths/disappearance and Ada Blackjack's survival until August 1923 rescue.
Confirms Soviet forces removed the island's remaining foreign settlers in 1924 and annexed it in 1926.
